reports.title: Announces Full Year and Fourth Quarter Results

lines: We monetized approximately $3.0 million of the PTCs during fiscal 2026 and expect to monetize the remaining PTCs and the ITCs during fiscal 2027.

desk.period: Q4 fiscal 2026 (quarter to 26 Sep 2026) and full year
desk.headline: Q4 revenue up 4% to $219.9m, beat; seasonal loss widened on impairments; distribution raised 7.7%, no outlook
results: Q4 is seasonally loss-making: the net loss widened to $56.8m ($0.85 a unit) from $35.1m, including $23.1m of losses and write-downs on outside investments and a $7.9m goodwill write-down in natural gas and electricity.
Underlying Q4 adjusted EBITDA rose to $7.3m from $0.7m, helped by $7.8m of RNG production tax credits; the RNG segment earned $8.6m vs a $2.6m loss.
Full year: revenue $1.40bn (down 2% on lower propane prices), net income $109.0m and adjusted EBITDA up 2.2% to $284.0m; propane gallons rose about 1% as a colder East offset a much warmer West.
Propane unit margins rose $0.05 a gallon; operating and admin costs rose 3.9% to $603.1m on payroll, fuel, vehicles and insurance claims.
Debt fell by more than $25m and leverage improved to 4.13x; $350m of 2027 notes were refinanced to 2035 at 6.5%, and the quarterly distribution was raised to $0.35 ($1.40 a year).

guidance.summary: No financial outlook for fiscal 2027. Suburban expects to cash in the rest of its RNG production tax credits and $11.3m of investment tax credits during fiscal 2027.

watch: Heating-season volumes and weather in the December and March quarters.
RNG output, the Columbus, Ohio start-up and cash received from tax credits.
